label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Keyboard focus started inside the cookie banner, but the banner had no heading or announcement, so I only learned of Accept and Reject by tabbing through them. Reject All worked with Enter.
Several tab stops before the navigation read as raw or unhelpful text: a link named Translation missing: en.accessibility.skip_to_chatbot, an accessibility-tool button, and an unnamed link.
Reaching the first product took many tab presses past the header; the Skip to content link was the only shortcut, and the product listing started only after Filter and Sort controls.
Many tab stops before the size choice: gallery images exposed as unnamed divs (Open media N in modal) and several links with no name (colour swatches), so I could not tell what they were.
After Add to bag, the bag drawer and its Product added to your bag message did not appear in the first read and focus ended on an unnamed button, so success was unclear until I read the page again.
The checkout page was blank on first read and the payment form appeared only on a second read, with nothing announcing the loading state.
